decisions.reason: As a low-risk extension of the firm's established wood-floor care range, it supports the announced full-system offer and there is no clear evidence yet that would overcome management's tendency to continue a recently launched, publicly presented product.

This maintenance oil fits tightly with the firm's core flooring business and after a recent launch management is likely to justify the investment and keep it on the market while attributing any early weakness to normal market-building.

Because this care product reinforces the firm's aftercare and customer-relationship strategy around wood floors, management would be inclined to continue it rather than reverse a visible and closely related launch after only one year.

The moisture-protection underlay complements the firm's flooring systems and installation guidance, so sunk development and commercialization efforts plus strategic fit make continued commitment likely.

This high-density underlay foam broadens the firm's installation accessory offer in a way consistent with its innovation path, and escalation of commitment makes an early withdrawal unlikely without strong negative evidence.

An oak parquet floor is close to the firm's core identity and likely required the most visible production and sales commitment, so management would be especially prone to keep it and give it more time to prove itself.
